references.text: The same expression that all Israel should hear and fear, used in the context of executing someone who acts rebelliously against the judges
Identical wording stating that others should hear and fear, and not do such evil again, in the context of false witnesses
The same principle that all Israel should hear and fear when a rebellious son is punished
Command to remove the evil from your midst, using the same expression as found here
Command to purge the evil from Israel, parallel to removing wickedness from among the people
Paul applies the same principle in the context of the church: rebuke sinners publicly so that others may fear
